headline: Supply Chain Manager
summary: Supply chain manager with ten years in agribusiness and consumer goods in Davao. I lead planning, purchasing and warehousing for a banana and processed-food company, use data to set strategy, and manage a team of 25. I have taken inventory days down while keeping service levels above 97%.
highlights: Cut inventory days on hand from 45 to 28 while holding service levels above 97%.
Set up a sales and operations planning process that aligned sales, production and purchasing every month.
Moved two warehouses to cross-docking for fast-moving goods, halving handling time.
skills: Supply chain trend and risk analysis

experience.title: Supply Chain Manager
bullets: Lead planning, purchasing, warehousing and distribution teams of 25 people.
Build monthly demand and supply plans and present them in the S&OP meeting.
Analyse supplier and freight trends and renegotiate contracts when costs shift.

experience.title: Inventory and Planning Supervisor
bullets: Planned raw material and packaging inventory for three production lines.
Oversaw labelling, repacking and kitting work in the warehouse.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering
education.school: Davao Institute of Engineering and Technology
